environment.description: AWS Lambda (Node.js 18) connected to Aurora PostgreSQL 15.4 via RDS Proxy with IAM authentication. The database connection role is 'app_tenant_reader' which was created with: CREATE ROLE app_tenant_reader NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION; ALTER ROLE app_tenant_reader SET row_security = on; GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_tenant_reader; RLS policies use current_setting('app.current_tenant') with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on all tables (ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY). The pg_hba.conf equivalent in Aurora parameter group has 'rds.force_ssl=1'. Additionally, a pgAudit extension logs all DDL and role-changing statements. The RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'rds.restrict_password_commands=1' preventing runtime role escalation.

config.db_role_privileges: NOSUPERUSER, no BYPASSRLS, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all tables
config.rls_policies: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON users USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid); CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON billing_records USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid); CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON tenant_data USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid)
config.force_rls: ALTER TABLE users FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE billing_records FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE tenant_data FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.rds_proxy: IAM auth, connection pinning for SET statements
config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validation, proxy integration
config.network: Lambda in VPC, connectivity via RDS Proxy only
